headlines.formula: COUNT DISTINCT province_code with qualifying programme coverage evidence
headlines.label_th: จังหวัดที่มีหลักฐานกิจกรรมหรือความครอบคลุมโครงการ
headlines.limitations: Provinces with some programme evidence do not establish complete data for every KPI in every province. Institution-only addresses do not qualify.
headlines.scope: Qualifying programme activity, area, product, participation and innovation-use evidence across supplied sources

headlines.formula: COUNT DISTINCT cultural area: AtLocal programme areas and Cultural Map cultural spaces; an area found in both counts once

headlines.limitations: Other mapped categories are not automatically cultural areas. Unresolved possible identities remain separately provisional.
headlines.scope: AtLocal areas and Cultural Map Cultural Space subjects

companions.formula: COUNT DISTINCT global_person_id with a community_innovator or inventor contribution; province scope uses accepted source-reported innovator province memberships
companions.label_th: บุคคลที่มีหลักฐานนวัตกรชุมชนในทะเบียน
companions.limitations: Province is the canonical province explicitly attached by the source to the innovator record; it is not residence or current workplace. People without admitted province evidence remain in the national total. Multiple province memberships may overlap and province counts are not additive. Researcher or owner alone does not qualify. Never add to or subtract from K02.

headlines.formula: SUM PMUA innovators_all province total_inno; reconcile to reported headline
headlines.label_th: นวัตกรตามยอดรวมที่ PMUA รายงาน
headlines.limitations: The source reports innovators by province group; a group without a province counts only in the national total. A province the source does not report returns unavailable, not zero. Named-person companions cannot explain or be subtracted from this total. Levels retain source labels without inferred skill meaning.
headlines.scope: PMUA all-scope captured aggregate, without a year filter

headlines.formula: COUNT DISTINCT global_activity_id in accepted reported activities
headlines.label_th: กิจกรรมโครงการที่มีรายงาน
headlines.limitations: Publications and sessions are not additional activities. Source-reported occurrence does not prove completion. Overseas activities remain in the overall total.
headlines.scope: AtLocal, Cultural Map and iCommunity reported occurrences, including workshops and meetings

companions.formula: COUNT DISTINCT global_innovation_id in broader listed inventory
companions.label_th: นวัตกรรมที่มีรายการทั้งหมด

headlines.formula: COUNT DISTINCT global_innovation_id with at least one eligible readiness assessment
headlines.label_th: นวัตกรรมที่มีหลักฐานความพร้อมตามเกณฑ์
headlines.limitations: Numeric 8-9 qualifies; valid numeric level takes precedence over a label within an assessment. Explicit ready label is fallback only. Apply iCommunity export-first and proven supersession. Preserve conflicts; no canonical maximum or verified-current claim.
headlines.scope: iCommunity, PMUA AppTech, RINMP and AppTech MRU after accepted identity resolution

headlines.formula: COUNT DISTINCT global_operator_id after source-contract cultural-business admission and accepted identity reconciliation

headlines.limitations: Partial coverage across seven reviewed sources, not a complete cultural-business population. All valid Learning area-based business IDs are eligible by source contract; ambiguous or missing labels remain provisional and do not remove eligibility. Identities are reconciled before counting, so C08 participation is not additive to K05. Unknown business geography is not borrowed from products or projects.
headlines.scope: Accepted catalogue businesses plus all source-declared Learning area-based cultural business units and reviewed Cultural Map/AtLocal/iCommunity/PMUA/RINMP/MRU business evidence; seven sources contribute

headlines.label_th: ผู้ประกอบการวัฒนธรรม — ยังไม่คำนวณในชุดส่งมอบนี้
headlines.limitations: The original 58-person inventory reflects uneven, incomplete discovery. User deferred calculation entirely. Neither 58 nor the 156-person pilot is a released result; absence of a total does not mean absence of supporting examples.

headlines.formula: COUNT DISTINCT family_id; ordinary variants within a supported maker context share one family; a broad range adds no extra parent count
headlines.label_th: ตระกูลสินค้า บริการ และผลงานที่มีหลักฐานรองรับ
headlines.limitations: Partial reviewed coverage. Existence or sale does not prove programme development. Ordinary flavour/filling/colour/size variants count once per supported family; distinct finished forms and confirmed designs remain separate. Global offering row count is not the KPI. Unenumerated totals are non-additive. Known unresolved identity and geography limitations remain visible.
headlines.scope: Accepted catalogue offerings plus reviewed actual outputs, prototypes, completed designs and systems from AtLocal, Cultural Map, iCommunity, PMUA, RINMP and AppTech MRU; Learning directory-only product claims excluded

companions.limitations: Directory businesses, with reviewed duplicates merged. Participation is not improvement. Not an established parent population of person assessments or the reported business total.

companions.limitations: No business roster or joint cross-tab. Never sum dimensions or add to the participating-business count. A missing member is unavailable unless the source explicitly reports zero.

companions.limitations: Multiple assessments per person do not add people. Undated source assessments are not a verified latest score.

companions.formula: COUNT DISTINCT global person with at least one complete assessment having any dimension delta > 0
companions.label_th: บุคคลที่รายงานคะแนนเพิ่มขึ้นอย่างน้อยหนึ่งด้าน
companions.limitations: Subset of C08_ASSESSED_PEOPLE, not businesses. Mixed increases/decreases remain visible. Missing assessments do not imply no improvement.

headlines.formula: COUNT DISTINCT eligible Cultural Map map_inspiration subject_id
headlines.label_th: รายการทุนหรือเรื่องทางวัฒนธรรมในแผนที่หลังขจัดรายการซ้ำ
headlines.limitations: Counts mapped subjects, not information systems or websites. Multiple category memberships do not add subjects. Other sources do not expand this user-defined population.
headlines.scope: All map_inspiration categories after accepted source deduplication

limitations: K12 includes every deduplicated map_inspiration subject, including named people and cultural knowledge holders. Reviewed possible duplicates retain separate provisional identities and their uncertainty. Names, aliases and informant matches do not exclude a K12 subject; private contacts, informant fields and sensitive personal details remain field-level exclusions.
K03 publications, dates, venues and sessions remain children of an occurrence and never add entities; source-reported occurrence does not prove completion.
Innovation readiness rows are source assertions, not individual development assessments and not claims of current verified readiness. Innovation geography uses only attached use locations.
Operator geography uses only operator-owned location rows. Offering geography is retained with the offering and is never borrowed by an operator.
K07 counts families. Every preserved offering, variant and range-evidence member remains a child; source-reported price does not prove a free, current or available offering.

C08_PARTICIPATING lists source-supported business units and their own participations, projects, research units and locations. Participation is not improvement; person assessment companions remain aggregate-only.

Text is plain-text excerpted and contact/access values are removed or the field is withheld. Links are HTTPS references constrained by source/host/path/query allowlists; no media availability or reuse rights are inferred.
